policy_prompt_for_subgoal: Coordinates are [y, x]. The right-side target is the one with the SMALLER x; the left-side target is the one with the LARGER x. First read the goal to get the required number of target visits REQ: if it says 'repeating this back and forth motion N times' then REQ = 2*N (two=4, three=6); if it instead says 'then put it down on the left-side target' then REQ = 2. Every episode starts with subgoal A. At each decision step FIRST update visits_done from what the step shows (per the memory instruction), THEN apply every rule below to the UPDATED value, never the carried-in one. Rules (apply whichever matches the current step and memory): 1. If the cube is NOT held in the gripper and visits_done is 0 (cube resting on the table, fingers open, nothing done yet): choose A, pick up the cube, pointing at the cube's center coordinates. 2. If the cube IS held in the gripper and visits_done < REQ: choose B, move to the top of the target. Pointing rule: if a highlighted target is visible in the scene, point at the target that is NOT highlighted (its listed coordinates); the highlighted one is the target just reached and is never the point. If no target is highlighted (just after pick-up), point at the right-side target (smaller x). As a check only, the updated visits_done parity should agree: even (0, 2, 4...) means the point is the right-side target, odd (1, 3, 5...) the left-side target. 3. If the cube IS held in the gripper and the updated visits_done >= REQ (the cube is now above the left-side target after the last required visit): choose C, put the cube on the table. 4. If the cube is NOT held in the gripper and the updated visits_done >= REQ (cube resting on the table after the put-down, fingers fully open, gripper raised): choose D, press the button. If no rule matches: when the cube is held, choose B pointing at the target that is not highlighted; when the cube is on the table and visits_done is 0, choose A at the cube; when the cube is on the table and visits_done > 0, choose D.

fields.name: visits_done
fields.description: Carry in the previous value (start at 0 on the first step, where memory is empty). Compute this field BEFORE choosing the subgoal; the subgoal rules read the updated value. Add 1 if and only if, at the scene of this decision step, the cube is 'held in the gripper' AND a 'highlighted target' is listed under/near the gripper AND, in the first execution frame shown for this step, that same position was listed only as a plain 'target' or no highlighted target was listed at all. The typical first case: the earlier frames of the step list only plain targets and the final scene lists one highlighted target under the held cube; that is an increment, 0 becomes 1. If the highlighted target in the final scene is the same one that was already highlighted in the first frame, do not add. Otherwise keep the carried-in value unchanged (the pick-up step, the put-down step where the cube ends on the table with fingers fully open, and the press-button step do not change it). e.g. 3
